targets.guidance: Publish each forcing value with UTC bounds, amount/rate/point class, unit and method; do not conceal accumulation behind a timestamp.
Reconcile forcing and routing intervals conservatively; retain source bounds and transformation lineage; reject overlap and gaps.
Mutate storage only from reconciled interval fluxes; never reapply reporting aggregates or treat rates as amounts.
Presentation interpolation may smooth display time but must not feed interpolated mass back into canonical state.
